report:
Reviewed the complete balanced_traces claim and all three ordinary implementation associations (src/inspector.rs, crates/sage-host/src/trace.rs, crates/sage-ir/src/db.rs), plus the sole associated TODO test. Requirements are: each tracked invocation has a balanced span; entry precedes memo lookup even for already-current reuse; terminal exit covers execution, validation, reuse, cancellation and unwinding. Captured vendor/salsa/src/function/fetch.rs shows fetch routes through refresh_memo_traced, which emits WillRequest and constructs RequestGuard before cancellation checking and refresh_memo. RequestGuard defaults to Cancelled and its Drop emits DidRequest; successful refresh replaces the disposition. fetch_hot distinguishes already-current Reused from revision validation, fetch_cold returns Validated for verification and Executed for execution, and cycle handling either unwinds through the same guard or returns a terminal disposition. Thus ordinary return, nested calls, cancellation before memo access and panic unwinding share the balanced guard. Captured vendor/salsa/src/function/accumulated.rs routes accumulator graph memo refreshes through that same lifecycle rather than bypassing it. These vendored files are outside workspace association inventory and are retained as explicit dependency fragments.

The Sage database event bridge records WillRequest as QueryEnter and DidRequest as QueryExit; adjacent completed identical leaves may be coalesced only after observing matching entry/exit pairs, retaining multiplicity. Its optional observers are explicitly required not to unwind. The trace projector pushes on entry, pops on exit, preserves all four terminal dispositions and attaches nested nodes to their parent. The provider drains the recorded events and invokes this projector when retaining a run. Missing or mismatched events produce diagnostic/observed nodes; this defensive handling does not replace lifecycle generation. Added essential implementation associations at the bridge and projector so future source changes invalidate this assessment.

Test evidence remains explicitly deferred. The only associated test is sage_meta::todo::crates_sage_inspector_inspection_balanced_traces; its empty body has no assertions and supplies no behavioral verification. Its comment identifies the prerequisite: associate and review the complete cold, warm, edited, nested, panicking and pre-fetch cancellation scenarios with balanced entry/exit and four terminal dispositions, plus accumulator traversal coverage. That is an adequate explicit evidence-integration deferral, not successful coverage. The unassociated accumulator test visible in the database file checks cold execution, warm reuse, validation and cancellation, but does not resolve the entire TODO matrix and is not counted as associated coverage. A missing guard on the hot reuse path or panic exit would require those deferred raw lifecycle assertions to detect it. No behavior change or reproduced failure is asserted. This report is source inspection, not test-execution evidence; no behavior tests were run for this review. cargo fmt --all was run after the comment-only association additions. No requested edits remain beyond the explicit, still-visible TODO evidence work.
